cases.sentence: Саул спустился в пустыню Зив с тремя тысячами ___.
cases.translation: Saul went down to the wilderness of Ziph with three thousand men.
cases.explain: After a number in oblique cases, masculine nouns take genitive plural.

cases.sentence: Он увидел, где Саул и начальник войска ___, сын Нира, легли спать.
cases.translation: He saw where Saul and Abner, the captain, lay down to sleep.
cases.explain: Авнер is the subject of the verb легли, requiring nominative case.

cases.sentence: Давид и Авишай пришли к ___ ночью.
cases.translation: David and Abishai came to the army at night.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Сегодня Бог отдал ___ в твои руки.
cases.translation: Today God delivered the enemy into your hands.
cases.explain: A transitive verb takes the accusative case for an animate object.

cases.sentence: Позволь же мне пригвоздить его к ___ одним ударом копья.
cases.translation: Let me pin him to the ground with one thrust of the spear.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicates location and takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Кто может поднять ___ на Господнего помазанника?
cases.translation: Who can raise a hand against the Lord anointed?
cases.explain: The verb поднять (raise) is transitive and takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Возьми-ка копье и кувшин для ___ у его изголовья.
cases.translation: Take the spear and water jug by his head.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: There was a great distance between them.
cases.explain: The predicate noun after было (was) stands in nominative case.

reading.ru: Зефиты пришли к Саулу в Гиву и сказали, «Разве Давид не прячется на холме Хахила, что напротив Иешимона?»
reading.question: What did the Ziphites tell Saul about David location?
options: David was hiding on the hill of Hachilah
David had escaped to the land of the Philistines
David was in the wilderness of Ziph
reading.correct: David was hiding on the hill of Hachilah
reading.explain: The Ziphites asked if David wasn not hiding on the hill of Hachilah.

reading.ru: Давид спросил Хетта Ахимелеха и Авишая, брата Иава, сына Саруи, «Кто спустится вместе со мной в лагерь к Саулу?»
reading.question: Whom did David ask to go with him to Saul camp?
reading.explain: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai to go with him.

reading.ru: Авишай сказал Давиду, «Сегодня Бог отдал врага в твои руки, позволь же мне пригвоздить его к земле одним ударом копья.»
reading.question: What did Abishai ask permission to do?
options: Strike Saul to the ground with the spear
Take Saul spear and water jug
reading.correct: Strike Saul to the ground with the spear
reading.explain: Abishai asked to pin Saul to the ground with one spear thrust.

reading.ru: Но Давид сказал Авишаю, «Не губи его. Кто может поднять руку на Господнего помазанника и остаться невиновным?»
reading.question: Why did David refuse to let Abishai kill Saul?
options: Because Saul was the Lord anointed
Because the Lord had commanded him
reading.correct: Because Saul was the Lord anointed
reading.explain: David said no one could raise a hand against the Lord anointed and be guiltless.

reading.ru: Давид перешел на другую сторону и встал на вершине горы вдали, между ними было большое расстояние.
reading.question: Where did David go after leaving Saul camp?
options: To the top of a mountain at a distance
To the land of the Philistines
reading.correct: To the top of a mountain at a distance
reading.explain: David went to the other side and stood on the mountain top afar off.

reading.ru: Саул сказал, Я согрешил. «Вернись, Давид, сын мой! Сегодня моя жизнь была для тебя драгоценной, и я не буду больше пытаться причинить тебе вред.»
reading.question: What did Saul say after realizing it was David?
options: He asked David to return and promised not to harm him
He tried to kill David again
reading.correct: He asked David to return and promised not to harm him
reading.explain: Saul asked David to return, saying his life was precious to him.
